Commentary.Commentary: Welcome back for the start of USA Under-19's batting effort! Uday Saharan and his boys disperse from the huddle and stride out to the centre. It will be Prannav Chettipalayam and Bhavya Mehta to open the innings for USA Under-19. Raj Limbani will start the proceedings with the new ball for India Under-19. Let's play...
...  THE RUN CHASE ....

On the other hand, the USA Under-19 bowlers had a wonderful start, putting pressure on the batters with all their dot deliveries in the first Powerplay, which helped them one way or the other to get their first wicket. They got a chance to dismiss Arshin Kulkarni when he was on 16 but Prannav Chettipalayam failed to hang on and they were made to pay for it. The wickets completely dried up in the middle overs, but thanks to their skipper, Rishi Ramesh, who helped USA Under-19 to get the breakthrough in the 36th over. As they entered their last ten overs, the bowlers picked up wickets at regular intervals and didn't allow their opposition to stretch their score with big boundaries. The bowlers gave away a lot of extras to their opposition. Ateendra Subramanian picked up 2 wickets while Arya Garg, Aarin Nadkarni and Rishi Ramesh chipped in for one each. The USA Under-19 have their backs against the wall and it will take a monumental effort to get over the line here. Join us in a bit to see how the chase unfolds.

Musheer Khan is in for a chat. He says he is happy to play and partner with Arshin Kulkarni as he had a significant knock. He also says that it is good for their team as all the top four batters are in form which will help them in the Super Six. He continues that Arshin had a few problems while running with him as compared to Uday Saharan but they communicated and coordinated well in the inning. Ends by saying that he is also looking to bowl in the second inning which he missed out last game.

India Under-19 finish on a high and they end up with a daunting total on the board! The openers of India Under-19 started their innings with a couple of boundaries but they were having a bit issue with running between the wickets and their intensity was a bit of a mismatch. They had a good partnership but it broke with the dismissal of Adarsh Singh. But Musheer Khan walked in at number 3 and anchored the situation pretty well. He and Arshin Kulkarni both communicated and formed a good steady 155-run partnership. Both of the batters completed their half-century but after some time in the 36th over, Musheer had to walk back to his hut after scoring 73 runs. Arhsin carried on and completed his century partnering with the skipper. As they entered the final powerplay they started going huge but they were pegged back a bit as Uday Saharan got dismissed after putting up a short cameo. Arshin also had to depart but only after scoring an exceptional inning. He also got a lifeline early in the innings and he made sure to capitalize on it. Towards the end, the middle-order batters did enough to surpass the score of 300 and ended up putting 326 runs on the board to defend.

The first ball in this final Group A clash is moments away but before that, the match officials and the two sets of players along with their mascots will line up for their respective national anthems. It will be the national anthem of the USA first followed by India's national anthem.

PITCH REPORT - Abhinav Mukund is near the deck. He says that they had rain last night and there are chances of a thunderstorm later in the afternoon. Mentions that the wicket is quite dry and they dry and there will not be much assistance for the pacers but feels that there will be some help for them with the new ball. Reckons that batters will have a field day but they need to take their time in the first Powerplay.

The captain of India Under-19, Uday Saharan says that they planned to bowl first but they are fine with batting first too. He continues that they are adapting to the atmosphere as they are going to have matches at this venue. He ends up saying that they are going to execute their plans and informs that they have made one change with Raj Limbani coming in for Dhanush Gowda.

The skipper of USA Under-19, Rishi Ramesh says that they will bowl first. Mentions that they like bowling first and adds that they have had good starts with the ball in the two games. On the other hand, the USA Under-19 would be happy enough to qualify for the Men's Under-19 World Cup after 14 years. But they would like to outfox the Boys in Blue and make a statement. The USA batters will face their biggest test till now, and it would be interesting to see how they come up against the spinners in this game. Arya Garg has stood out in the bowling unit to give a consistent performance despite all odds. He has picked up five wickets in two matches and will try to convey the same intensity in this match. India Under-19 have been unbeaten so far in the World Cup. They are currently sitting at the top of the table despite playing one less match.
